text:
Alex Turner: Anyone up for a spontaneous 'Rogue Smash' LAN tonight? :joystick: PS vs Switch vs Steam Deck — mix of roguelites and Smash?
Priya Singh: I can bring my Switch + neon dock and a power strip. Which roguelite though — Hades, Spelunky, Dead Cells?
Mateo Alvarez: I have Hades and Risk of Rain 2 on Steam. Can stream from my Deck if the Wi‑Fi is stable. steam store link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145360/Hades/
Jin Park: Count me in. I can bring extra ethernet cables and a small speaker. Also down for a Smash side tourney :trophy:
Alex Turner: Sweet. Thinking quick 3-round brackets so people can bounce in/out. 
Priya Singh: Poll idea: 1) Hades 2) Spelunky 3) Dead Cells 4) Risk of Rain 2 — vote by emoji? :one: :two: :three: :four:
Mateo Alvarez: FYI if anyone wants to stream Deck -> PC for local play, turn off the Steam overlay if inputs act weird: Settings > Controller > General Controller Settings (uncheck) — worked for me.
Jin Park: Smash rules proposal: 2 stock, 8 min, items off, Omega stages allowed. Simple and fast.
OpsBot: Mezzanine room "LAN‑C" reserved 7:00pm–11:00pm. RSVPs recorded: Alex Turner, Priya Singh, Mateo Alvarez, Jin Park.
Priya Singh: I'll spin up a tiny bracket sheet: https://tinyurl.com/rglan-bracket — will add slots and a snack list.
Alex Turner: Great. I'll bring spare controllers and some cable adapters. @here see you 7pm, snacks welcome :pizza:
